title: Artificial Intelligence, Intrapartum Ultrasound and Dystocic Delivery: AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Dystocia Algorithm), a Promising Helping Decision Support System.
summary: AIDA applies learned intrapartum ultrasound features to classify dystocic delivery outcomes. Results evaluates predictions against delivery outcomes in the study cohort; clinical decision-support evidence remains bounded.
